payload.title: HR CertificationExpired events are published by hr-service but consumed by no service, and AlertModule has no HR value, so an expired employee certification raises no alarm anywhere
evidence: apps/hr-service/src/training/certification-expiry.service.ts:122-138 (event published after commit 'so consumers see consistent state')
apps/alert-engine/src/alert/entities/alert-module.enum.ts:12-25 (alarm sources are farm and sensor only; the enum has no HR value)
